description: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1) will be open to geldings beginning next year after the European Pattern Committee approved France Galop's decision to remove the restriction on one of the world's greatest races.

description: A relatively new state law in New York proved critical in preventing more than two dozen horses from being shipped to slaughter in Canada, according to New York State Police.

description: J. Keeler Johnson handicaps the 2026 Del Mar Futurity (G1) and Del Mar Debutante (G1) at Del Mar.

description: Having reached the pinnacle of owning a Thoroughbred filly with 2019 Kentucky Oaks (G1) winner Serengeti Empress, Dr. Joel Politi hopes he can reach the top again when Stress Relief runs in the Spinaway Stakes (G1) Sept. 5 at Saratoga Race Course.
